name: 打印Hierarchy结构
cmd:
local Scene = CS.UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager
local lines = {}
local function traverse(tf, depth)
    local indent = string.rep("  ", depth)
    local go = tf.gameObject
    local tag = ""
    if not go.activeSelf then
        tag = " [inactive]"
    end
    local childCount = tf.childCount
    local comp = ""
    if childCount > 0 then
        comp = " (" .. childCount .. ")"
    end
    table.insert(lines, indent .. tf.name .. comp .. tag)
    for i = 0, childCount - 1 do
        traverse(tf:GetChild(i), depth + 1)
    end
end
local sceneCount = Scene.sceneCount
for s = 0, sceneCount - 1 do
    local scene = Scene.GetSceneAt(s)
    table.insert(lines, "===== Scene: " .. scene.name .. " =====")
    local roots = scene:GetRootGameObjects()
    for i = 0, roots.Length - 1 do
        traverse(roots[i].transform, 0)
    end
end
print(table.concat(lines, "\n"))

name: 打开demoRecommendRoleDetail
cmd:
do
    local DebugBaseCfgId = nil -- 想指定方案就填数字，例如 1；nil 会自动取当前表里最小的方案Id
    local agency = XMVCA and XMVCA.XTeamRecommend

    local function IsValidNumber(value)
        if XTool and XTool.IsNumberValid then
            return XTool.IsNumberValid(value)
        end
        return type(value) == "number" and value > 0
    end

    local function FindCfg(baseCfgId)
        if IsValidNumber(baseCfgId) then
            return agency:GetTeamRecommendBaseCharacter(baseCfgId)
        end

        local allCfgs = agency:GetTeamRecommendBaseCharacter()
        local minId
        local result
        for id, cfg in pairs(allCfgs or {}) do
            local cfgId = tonumber(cfg and cfg.Id or id)
            if cfgId and (not minId or cfgId < minId) then
                minId = cfgId
                result = cfg
            end
        end
        return result
    end

    local function FindTargetName(cfg)
        local characterId = cfg and cfg.CharacterId
        if not IsValidNumber(characterId) then
            return "Debug Preview"
        end

        local ids = agency:GetCharacterTargetBaseCharacterIds(characterId) or {}
        local names = agency:GetCharacterTargetNames(characterId) or {}
        for i, id in ipairs(ids) do
            if id == cfg.Id then
                return names[i] or "Debug Preview"
            end
        end
        return "Debug Preview"
    end

    if not agency then
        XLog.Error("[TeamRecommendDebug] XMVCA.XTeamRecommend is nil")
        return
    end

    local cfg = FindCfg(DebugBaseCfgId)
    if not cfg then
        XLog.Error("[TeamRecommendDebug] Cannot find TeamRecommendBaseCharacter config")
        return
    end

    local data = agency:FromCfgData(cfg)
    if not data then
        XLog.Error("[TeamRecommendDebug] FromCfgData failed, BaseCfgId=" .. tostring(cfg.Id))
        return
    end

    XLuaUiManager.Open("UiTeamRecommendRoleTargetDetail", data, nil, FindTargetName(cfg))

    XLog.Debug("[TeamRecommendDebug] Open UiTeamRecommendRoleDetail, BaseCfgId="
        .. tostring(cfg.Id) .. ", CharacterId=" .. tostring(data.CharacterId))
end

name: Stage托管-开启(通用攻击)
cmd:
do
    local function safe(fn, fallback)
        local ok, value = pcall(fn)
        if ok then return value end
        return fallback
    end
    local function log(k, v)
        print("[StagePilot] " .. tostring(k) .. "=" .. tostring(v))
    end
    local function scheduler()
        return rawget(_G, "XScheduleManager") or CS.XScheduleManager
    end

    local old = rawget(_G, "_HaruStagePilot")
    if old and old.stop then pcall(old.stop, "restart") end

    local P = {
        running = false,
        timer = nil,
        tick = 0,
        intervalMs = 160,
        nextFrame = 0,
        lastAttackTick = -999,
        lastBallTick = -999,
        lastDodgeTick = -999,
        lastOpTick = -999,
        lastMoveTick = -999,
        lastEnemyAction = nil,
        lastEnemyId = nil,
        specialBallLogged = false,
        matrixUntilTick = -999,
        postDodgeOffenseUntilTick = -999,
        attackCadenceTicks = 3,
        ballCooldownTicks = 5,
        dodgeCooldownTicks = 10,
        opCooldownTicks = 2,
        dodgeFloor = 520,
        nearDist2 = 2.25,
        closeDist2 = 4,
        evadeSkillDist2 = 4,
        moveFrames = 6,
        attackLockFrames = 5,
        ballLockFrames = 10,
        dodgeLockFrames = 10,
        overflowBallCount = 7,
    }
    rawset(_G, "_HaruStagePilot", P)

    P.KEYS = { attack = 15, dodge = 16, ex = 17, guide = 73, skip = 81 }
    for i = 1, 10 do P.KEYS["ball" .. tostring(i)] = i end

    local function topUi()
        return tostring(safe(function() return XLuaUiManager.GetTopUiName() end, ""))
    end
    local function isSettleTop(top)
        return top == "UiSettleWin"
            or top == "UiSettleWinMainLine"
            or top == "UiSettleWinSingleBoss"
            or top == "UiMainLine2Settlement"
            or top == "UiSettleLose"
    end
    local function isStoryTop(top)
        return top == "UiGuideFight"
            or top == "UiFightMovieTalkNew"
            or top == "UiFightTutorial"
            or top == "UiDialog"
            or top == "UiSystemDialog"
    end
    local function fight()
        return safe(function() return CS.XFight.Instance end, nil)
    end
    local function role(f)
        return f and safe(function() return f:GetClientRole() end, nil) or nil
    end
    local function roleNpc(f)
        local r = role(f)
        return r and r.Npc or nil, r
    end
    local function currentAction(npc)
        return tostring(safe(function() return npc and npc.CurrentAction or "" end, ""))
    end
    local function hasText(text, needle)
        return string.find(tostring(text or ""), needle, 1, true) ~= nil
    end
    local function fixToNumber(value, fallback)
        local n = tonumber(value)
        if n ~= nil then return n end
        local text = tostring(value)
        local head = string.match(text, "^%s*(-?%d+%.?%d*)")
        return tonumber(head) or fallback
    end
    local function dist2(a, b)
        return fixToNumber(safe(function()
            return CS.Mathematics.math.lengthsq(a.Position - b.Position)
        end, nil), 999999)
    end
    local function toInt(value)
        return tonumber(safe(function() return CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(value) end, nil))
            or tonumber(value)
            or tonumber(tostring(value))
    end

    function P.newOp()
        local op = CS.XFightOperation()
        op.SpecialOperation = CS.System.Collections.Generic.List(CS.System.UInt16)()
        return op
    end
    function P.inputOp(op, offset)
        local f = fight()
        local r = role(f)
        if not (f and r and op) then return false end
        offset = tonumber(offset or 1) or 1
        if offset < 1 then offset = 1 end
        return safe(function()
            return f.OperationProxy:InputOperation(f.Frame + offset, r.Index, op)
        end, false)
    end
    function P.tap(name, offset, holdFrames)
        local key = type(name) == "number" and name or P.KEYS[string.lower(tostring(name or ""))]
        if key == nil then return false end
        holdFrames = tonumber(holdFrames or 0) or 0
        if holdFrames <= 0 then
            local op = P.newOp()
            op.ClickOperation:Add(CS.XOperationProxy.ToClickOperation(key, CS.XOperationClickType.KeyDown))
            op.ClickOperation:Add(CS.XOperationProxy.ToClickOperation(key, CS.XOperationClickType.KeyUp))
            return P.inputOp(op, offset or 1)
        end
        local down = P.newOp()
        down.ClickOperation:Add(CS.XOperationProxy.ToClickOperation(key, CS.XOperationClickType.KeyDown))
        local okDown = P.inputOp(down, offset or 1)
        local up = P.newOp()
        up.ClickOperation:Add(CS.XOperationProxy.ToClickOperation(key, CS.XOperationClickType.KeyUp))
        local okUp = P.inputOp(up, (offset or 1) + holdFrames)
        return okDown and okUp
    end
    function P.moveDir(dirIndex, frames, offset, stop)
        dirIndex = (tonumber(dirIndex or 0) or 0) % 128
        frames = tonumber(frames or 1) or 1
        offset = tonumber(offset or 1) or 1
        for i = 0, frames - 1 do
            local op = P.newOp()
            op.MoveOperated = true
            op.MoveOperation = 128 + dirIndex
            P.inputOp(op, offset + i)
        end
        if stop ~= false then
            local op = P.newOp()
            op.MoveOperated = true
            op.MoveOperation = 0
            P.inputOp(op, offset + frames)
        end
    end
    function P.stopMove()
        local op = P.newOp()
        op.MoveOperated = true
        op.MoveOperation = 0
        P.inputOp(op, 1)
        local npc = roleNpc(fight())
        if npc then safe(function() npc:StopMove() end, nil) end
    end

    local function enumMap(enumType)
        local result = {}
        local values = safe(function() return CS.System.Enum.GetValues(enumType) end, nil)
        if values == nil then return result end
        local length = safe(function() return values.Length end, nil)
        if length ~= nil then
            for i = 0, tonumber(length) - 1 do
                local value = safe(function() return values:GetValue(i) end, nil)
                local id = toInt(value)
                if id ~= nil then result[id] = tostring(value) end
            end
            return result
        end
        local iter = safe(function() return values:GetEnumerator() end, nil)
        if iter ~= nil then
            while iter:MoveNext() do
                local value = iter.Current
                local id = toInt(value)
                if id ~= nil then result[id] = tostring(value) end
            end
        end
        return result
    end
    function P.clickKeyMap()
        P._ClickKeyMap = P._ClickKeyMap or enumMap(typeof(CS.XNpcOperationClickKey))
        return P._ClickKeyMap
    end
    function P.clickKeyName(key)
        return P.clickKeyMap()[tonumber(key or 0) or 0] or ("Key" .. tostring(key))
    end
    function P.clickCategory(name)
        local text = string.lower(tostring(name or ""))
        if string.find(text, "story", 1, true) or string.find(text, "talkoption", 1, true) then return "story" end
        if string.find(text, "qte", 1, true) then return "qte" end
        if string.find(text, "interact", 1, true)
            or string.find(text, "capture", 1, true)
            or string.find(text, "minigame", 1, true)
            or string.find(text, "easter", 1, true)
            or string.find(text, "custom", 1, true) then
            return "interact"
        end
        return "other"
    end
    function P.isRuntimeOperationCategory(category)
        return category == "story" or category == "qte" or category == "interact"
    end
    function P.getFightUiByKey(f, key)
        return safe(function() return f.UiManager:GetUiByKey(tonumber(key or 0) or 0, 0) end, nil)
    end
    function P.isTransformActive(value)
        return safe(function()
            local go = value and (value.gameObject or value)
            return go ~= nil and go.activeInHierarchy == true
        end, false)
    end
    function P.queryClickState(input, key)
        if input == nil then return nil end
        local byteKey = CS.System.Convert.ToByte(tonumber(key or 0) or 0)
        local direct = safe(function() return input:QueryClickState(byteKey) end, nil)
        if direct ~= nil then return direct end
        return safe(function()
            local BF = CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags
            local method = input:GetType():GetMethod("QueryClickState", BF.NonPublic | BF.Instance)
            if method == nil then method = input:GetType():GetMethod("QueryClickState", BF.Public | BF.Instance) end
            if method == nil then return nil end
            local args = CS.System.Array.CreateInstance(typeof(CS.System.Object), 1)
            args:SetValue(byteKey, 0)
            return method:Invoke(input, args)
        end, nil)
    end
    function P.highestOperation(npc)
        local raw = tonumber(safe(function() return npc and npc.HighestPriorityClickOperation or 0 end, 0)) or 0
        if raw <= 0 then return nil end
        local key = toInt(safe(function() return CS.XOperationProxy.ClickKey(raw) end, 0)) or 0
        local keyName = P.clickKeyName(key)
        local category = P.clickCategory(keyName)
        return { key = key, key_name = keyName, category = category }
    end
    local function opPriority(row)
        local name = string.lower(tostring(row.key_name or ""))
        if row.category == "story" then
            if string.find(name, "next", 1, true) then return 10 end
            if string.find(name, "end", 1, true) then return 20 end
            if string.find(name, "skip", 1, true) then return 80 end
            return 30
        end
        if row.category == "qte" then return 15 end
        if row.category == "interact" then return 25 end
        return 90
    end
    function P.chooseOperation(f, npc, preferredCategory)
        preferredCategory = tostring(preferredCategory or "auto")
        local high = P.highestOperation(npc)
        if high ~= nil and P.isRuntimeOperationCategory(high.category) then
            if preferredCategory == "auto" or preferredCategory == high.category then return high end
        end
        local rows = {}
        local input = safe(function() return f.InputControl end, nil)
        for key, name in pairs(P.clickKeyMap()) do
            key = tonumber(key or 0) or 0
            if key > 0 and key <= 200 then
                local category = P.clickCategory(name)
                if P.isRuntimeOperationCategory(category) then
                    local ui = P.getFightUiByKey(f, key)
                    local active = P.isTransformActive(ui)
                    local query = P.queryClickState(input, key)
                    if active == true or query == true then
                        rows[#rows + 1] = { key = key, key_name = name, category = category }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
            local pa = opPriority(a)
            local pb = opPriority(b)
            if pa ~= pb then return pa < pb end
            return a.key < b.key
        end)
        for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
            if preferredCategory == "auto" or preferredCategory == row.category then return row end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function P.operationStep(force, preferredCategory)
        local f = fight()
        local npc = roleNpc(f)
        if not (f and npc) then return false end
        local info = P.chooseOperation(f, npc, preferredCategory or "auto")
        if info == nil then return false end
        local key = CS.System.Convert.ToByte(info.key)
        local useForce = force == true
        local okDown = safe(function() f.InputControl:OnClick(key, CS.XOperationClickType.KeyDown, useForce) return true end, false)
        local okUp = safe(function() f.InputControl:OnClick(key, CS.XOperationClickType.KeyUp, useForce) return true end, false)
        if okDown and okUp then log("operation", tostring(info.category) .. ":" .. tostring(info.key_name)) end
        return okDown and okUp
    end

    function P.isNavigatingPhase(f)
        return safe(function()
            local ui = f.UiManager:GetUi(typeof(CS.XUiFightNavigationMarker))
            if ui == nil then return false end
            local BF = CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags
            local ents = ui:GetType():GetField('Entities', BF.NonPublic | BF.Instance):GetValue(ui)
            if ents == nil or ents.Count == 0 then return false end
            local it = ents:GetEnumerator()
            while it:MoveNext() do
                local target = it.Current.Value.FollowNpc
                if target ~= nil and not target.IsDead then return true end
            end
            return false
        end, false)
    end
    function P.getNavigationMarkerTarget(f)
        return safe(function()
            local BF = CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags
            local ui = f.UiManager:GetUi(typeof(CS.XUiFightNavigationMarker))
            if ui == nil then return nil end
            local ents = ui:GetType():GetField('Entities', BF.NonPublic | BF.Instance):GetValue(ui)
            if ents == nil or ents.Count == 0 then return nil end
            local it = ents:GetEnumerator()
            while it:MoveNext() do
                local target = it.Current.Value.FollowNpc
                if target ~= nil and not target.IsDead then return target end
            end
            return nil
        end, nil)
    end
    function P.requestMove(npc, targetPos)
        return safe(function()
            if npc == nil or targetPos == nil then return false end
            npc:DoMove(targetPos)
            return true
        end, false)
    end

    function P.isUtilityNpcName(name)
        name = tostring(name or "")
        return string.find(name, "通用召唤物", 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(name, "分身", 1, true) ~= nil
    end
    function P.isPlayerCampNpc(npc)
        return safe(function() return npc.IsPlayerCamp end, false) == true
            or safe(function() return npc:IsAllyPlayer() end, false) == true
    end
    function P.npcLife(npc)
        return tonumber(safe(function() return npc and npc.Life and npc.Life.Value or 0 end, 0)) or 0
    end
    function P.isRealEnemy(npc, allowHiddenHp)
        if npc == nil or npc.Role ~= nil or npc.IsDead then return false end
        if P.npcLife(npc) <= 0 then return false end
        if P.isUtilityNpcName(safe(function() return npc.Name end, "")) or P.isPlayerCampNpc(npc) then return false end
        if not allowHiddenHp and safe(function() return npc.RLNpc == nil or npc.RLNpc.ShowHp ~= false end, true) ~= true then return false end
        return true
    end
    function P.recordTarget(npc, index)
        return safe(function() return npc.RecordNpc[index] end, nil)
    end
    function P.addEnemy(list, seen, roleNpcValue, candidate, source, priority, allowHiddenHp)
        if not P.isRealEnemy(candidate, allowHiddenHp) then return end
        local id = safe(function() return candidate.Id end, 0)
        if seen[id] then return end
        seen[id] = true
        list[#list + 1] = {
            npc = candidate,
            id = id,
            source = source,
            priority = priority or 9,
            dist = dist2(candidate, roleNpcValue),
        }
    end
    function P.scanEnemies(f, npc)
        local enemies, seen = {}, {}
        P.addEnemy(enemies, seen, npc, P.recordTarget(npc, 9), "fight_target", 0, true)
        P.addEnemy(enemies, seen, npc, P.recordTarget(npc, 8), "focus_target", 1, true)
        safe(function()
            local iter = f.NpcManager:GetNpcTable():GetEnumerator()
            while iter:MoveNext() do
                P.addEnemy(enemies, seen, npc, iter.Current.Value, "scan", 2, false)
            end
        end, nil)
        table.sort(enemies, function(a, b)
            if a.priority ~= b.priority then return a.priority < b.priority end
            return a.dist < b.dist
        end)
        return enemies
    end

    function P.isStandardBallKey(key)
        key = tonumber(key or 0) or 0
        return key >= 1 and key <= 3
    end
    function P.getBalls(npc)
        local fbc = npc and safe(function() return npc.FightBallControl end, nil) or nil
        local balls = {}
        if not fbc then return balls end
        local layer = safe(function() return CS.XFightBallControl.DEFAULT_BALL_LAYER end, 0)
        local count = tonumber(safe(function() return fbc:GetFightContainerCount(layer) end, 0) or 0) or 0
        for i = 0, count - 1 do
            local ball = safe(function() return fbc:GetFightBallContainerData(layer, i) end, nil)
            local key = tonumber(ball and ball.Key or 0) or 0
            local group = tonumber(ball and ball.GroupItemCount or 0) or 0
            local ready = ball ~= nil and ball.IsReady == true
            balls[#balls + 1] = { index = i + 1, key = key, group = group, ready = ready }
            if ready and key > 0 and not P.isStandardBallKey(key) and P.specialBallLogged ~= true then
                P.specialBallLogged = true
                log("special_ball_fallback", "rgb_only")
            end
        end
        return balls
    end
    function P.countReadyBalls(balls)
        local readyCount, readyItemCount = 0, 0
        for _, ball in ipairs(balls) do
            if ball.ready and P.isStandardBallKey(ball.key) then
                readyCount = readyCount + 1
                readyItemCount = readyItemCount + (tonumber(ball.group or 0) or 0)
            end
        end
        return readyCount, readyItemCount
    end
    function P.findReadyBall(balls, minGroup)
        minGroup = tonumber(minGroup or 3) or 3
        for _, ball in ipairs(balls) do
            if ball.ready and P.isStandardBallKey(ball.key) and ball.group >= minGroup then
                return ball.index, ball.key, ball.group
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function P.findBestReadyBallExcludingKey(balls, excludedKey, minGroup)
        excludedKey = tonumber(excludedKey or 0) or 0
        minGroup = tonumber(minGroup or 1) or 1
        local bestIndex, bestKey, bestGroup = nil, nil, -1
        for _, ball in ipairs(balls) do
            if ball.ready and P.isStandardBallKey(ball.key) and ball.key ~= excludedKey and ball.group >= minGroup and ball.group > bestGroup then
                bestIndex, bestKey, bestGroup = ball.index, ball.key, ball.group
            end
        end
        return bestIndex, bestKey, bestGroup
    end
    function P.findMergeSetupBall(balls, minMergedCount)
        minMergedCount = tonumber(minMergedCount or 3) or 3
        local bestIndex, bestKey, bestGroup, bestMergeKey, bestMergeCount, bestScore = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, -999999
        for i = 2, #balls - 1 do
            local middle = balls[i]
            if middle and middle.ready and P.isStandardBallKey(middle.key) and (middle.group or 0) <= 1 then
                local left = balls[i - 1]
                local right = balls[i + 1]
                if left and right and left.ready and right.ready and P.isStandardBallKey(left.key)
                    and left.key == right.key and middle.key ~= left.key then
                    local leftCount, li = 0, i - 1
                    while li >= 1 and balls[li] and balls[li].ready and balls[li].key == left.key do
                        leftCount = leftCount + 1
                        li = li - 1
                    end
                    local rightCount, ri = 0, i + 1
                    while ri <= #balls and balls[ri] and balls[ri].ready and balls[ri].key == left.key do
                        rightCount = rightCount + 1
                        ri = ri + 1
                    end
                    local mergedCount = math.max(leftCount, tonumber(left.group or 0) or 0) + math.max(rightCount, tonumber(right.group or 0) or 0)
                    if mergedCount >= minMergedCount then
                        local score = mergedCount * 100 - (middle.group or 0) * 10
                        if score > bestScore then
                            bestIndex, bestKey, bestGroup = middle.index, middle.key, middle.group
                            bestMergeKey, bestMergeCount, bestScore = left.key, mergedCount, score
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return bestIndex, bestKey, bestGroup, bestMergeKey, bestMergeCount
    end
    function P.detectMatrix(npc, targetNpc)
        local tick = P.tick or 0
        if tick <= (P.matrixUntilTick or -999) then return true end
        local selfTs = fixToNumber(safe(function() return npc.TimeComponent.TimeScale end, 1), 1)
        local targetTs = fixToNumber(safe(function() return targetNpc.TimeComponent.TimeScale end, 1), 1)
        local recentDodge = tick - (P.lastDodgeTick or -999) <= 10
        local dodgeState = tostring(safe(function() return npc.CurSkillDodgeState end, ""))
        local slow = targetTs >= 0 and selfTs >= 0.5 and targetTs <= math.max(0.05, selfTs * 0.45)
        local active = slow and (recentDodge or string.find(dodgeState, "Deplete", 1, true) ~= nil)
        if active then P.matrixUntilTick = tick + 12 end
        return active
    end
    function P.chooseBall(npc, matrixActive)
        local balls = P.getBalls(npc)
        if matrixActive == true then
            local index, key, group = P.findBestReadyBallExcludingKey(balls, 0, 1)
            if index then return index, key, group, "matrix_three_ping" end
        end
        local index, key, group = P.findReadyBall(balls, 3)
        if index then return index, key, group, "three_ping" end
        local mergeIndex, mergeKey, mergeGroup, mergeResultKey, mergeResultCount = P.findMergeSetupBall(balls, 3)
        if mergeIndex then return mergeIndex, mergeKey, mergeGroup, "merge_to_" .. tostring(mergeResultKey) .. "x" .. tostring(mergeResultCount) end
        local readyCount, readyItemCount = P.countReadyBalls(balls)
        if readyCount >= P.overflowBallCount or readyItemCount >= P.overflowBallCount then
            index, key, group = P.findBestReadyBallExcludingKey(balls, 0, 2)
            if index then return index, key, group, "overflow_2plus" end
        end
        return nil, nil, nil, "build_three_ping"
    end

    function P.navigateTo(npc, targetNpc)
        local targetPos = safe(function() return targetNpc.Position end, nil)
        if targetPos == nil then return end
        local d2 = dist2(targetNpc, npc)
        if d2 > 1.5 then
            if not P.requestMove(npc, targetPos) then
                local dir = tonumber(safe(function() return CS.XMath.DirToIndex(targetNpc.Position - npc.Position) end, 0) or 0) or 0
                P.moveDir(dir, P.moveFrames, 1, true)
            end
        else
            P.stopMove()
        end
    end

    function P.combatStep(f, npc, targetNpc, navigating)
        local frame = tonumber(safe(function() return f.Frame end, 0) or 0) or 0
        local targetD2 = dist2(targetNpc, npc)
        local myAction = currentAction(npc)
        local enemyAction = currentAction(targetNpc)
        local enemyUsingSkill = hasText(enemyAction, "Skill")
        local enemyId = safe(function() return targetNpc.Id end, 0)
        local enemySkillStarted = enemyUsingSkill and not (P.lastEnemyId == enemyId and P.lastEnemyAction == enemyAction)
        local isBeingHit = hasText(myAction, "BeHit")
        local inDefault = hasText(myAction, "Default")
        local inAttack = hasText(myAction, "Attack")
        local inDodge = hasText(myAction, "Dodge")
        local canCancel = inDefault or inAttack or hasText(myAction, "Walk") or hasText(myAction, "Sprint")
        local canActNow = canCancel or (frame >= (P.nextFrame or 0) and not inDodge)
        local dodgeEnergy = tonumber(safe(function() return npc.DodgeEnergy.Value end, 0) or 0) or 0
        local dodgeReady = dodgeEnergy >= P.dodgeFloor and (P.tick - P.lastDodgeTick) >= P.dodgeCooldownTicks
        local matrixActive = P.detectMatrix(npc, targetNpc)

        if navigating == true then
            P.navigateTo(npc, targetNpc)
            P.lastEnemyId = enemyId
            P.lastEnemyAction = enemyAction
            return
        end

        if targetD2 > P.nearDist2 then
            local targetPos = safe(function() return targetNpc.Position end, nil)
            if targetPos ~= nil then
                if targetD2 > P.closeDist2 then
                    P.requestMove(npc, targetPos)
                else
                    local dir = tonumber(safe(function() return CS.XMath.DirToIndex(targetNpc.Position - npc.Position) end, 0) or 0) or 0
                    P.moveDir(dir, P.moveFrames, 1, true)
                end
            end
        end

        local ballIndex, ballKey, groupCount, ballPlan = P.chooseBall(npc, matrixActive)
        local ballReady = ballIndex ~= nil and (P.tick - P.lastBallTick) >= P.ballCooldownTicks
        local attackDue = (P.tick - P.lastAttackTick) >= P.attackCadenceTicks

        if isBeingHit and dodgeReady then
            P.tap("dodge", 3, 0)
            P.lastDodgeTick = P.tick
            P.postDodgeOffenseUntilTick = P.tick + 10
            P.nextFrame = frame + P.dodgeLockFrames
            log("action", "dodge_hit")
        elseif enemyUsingSkill and enemySkillStarted and targetD2 <= P.evadeSkillDist2 and dodgeReady and not inDodge and (canCancel or isBeingHit) then
            P.tap("dodge", 3, 0)
            P.lastDodgeTick = P.tick
            P.postDodgeOffenseUntilTick = P.tick + 10
            P.nextFrame = frame + P.dodgeLockFrames
            log("action", "dodge_skill_close")
        elseif ballReady and canCancel then
            P.tap("ball" .. tostring(ballIndex), 5, 0)
            P.lastBallTick = P.tick
            P.nextFrame = frame + P.ballLockFrames
            log("ball", tostring(ballPlan) .. ":" .. tostring(ballIndex) .. ":k" .. tostring(ballKey) .. "x" .. tostring(groupCount))
        elseif attackDue and (canActNow or inAttack) then
            P.tap("attack", 5, 0)
            P.lastAttackTick = P.tick
            P.nextFrame = frame + P.attackLockFrames
        end
        P.lastEnemyId = enemyId
        P.lastEnemyAction = enemyAction
    end

    function P.step()
        P.tick = (P.tick or 0) + 1
        local top = topUi()
        if isSettleTop(top) then P.stop("settle:" .. top) return end
        local f = fight()
        local npc, r = roleNpc(f)
        if not (f and npc and npc.IsDead ~= true) then return end
        if f.IsReplay or f.OnlineConnect or f.ShieldOperation then P.stop("guard") return end

        local storyTop = isStoryTop(top)
        if (storyTop or (P.tick % 2) == 0) and (P.tick - P.lastOpTick) >= P.opCooldownTicks then
            if P.operationStep(false, "auto") then
                P.lastOpTick = P.tick
                if storyTop then return end
            elseif storyTop then
                return
            end
        end

        local navigating = P.isNavigatingPhase(f)
        local targetNpc = nil
        if navigating then targetNpc = P.getNavigationMarkerTarget(f) end
        if targetNpc == nil then
            local enemies = P.scanEnemies(f, npc)
            if #enemies > 0 then targetNpc = enemies[1].npc end
        end
        if targetNpc == nil then return end
        P.combatStep(f, npc, targetNpc, navigating)
    end

    function P.stop(reason)
        reason = tostring(reason or "manual")
        if P.timer ~= nil then safe(function() scheduler().UnSchedule(P.timer) end, nil) end
        P.timer = nil
        P.running = false
        P.stopMove()
        log("stop", reason)
    end

    P.running = true
    P.timer = scheduler().ScheduleForever(function()
        local ok, err = pcall(function() P.step() end)
        if not ok then P.stop("error:" .. tostring(err)) end
    end, P.intervalMs, 0)
    log("start", "ok timer=" .. tostring(P.timer) .. ",self_contained=true,ball=three_ping_merge_rgb_only,attack_bias=true")
end

            if role and role.Npc then pcall(function() role.Npc:StopMove() end) end
            if fight and role then
                local op = CS.XFightOperation()
                op.SpecialOperation = CS.System.Collections.Generic.List(CS.System.UInt16)()
                op.MoveOperated = true
                op.MoveOperation = 0
                fight.OperationProxy:InputOperation(fight.Frame + 1, role.Index, op)
            end
        end, nil)

    local H = rawget(_G, "_HaruFightAgent")

        safe(function() H.stopNav("stage_pilot_off") end, nil)
    end

end
